answer: Each identity enrolls one retinal-vessel pattern in the Haven Registry: a fundus camera mirror-scans the vessels behind the eye, hashed on-chain with a 30 POA bond held 90 days. Each epoch a random 6-digit umber seal calls for a fresh mirror scan above 0.97 within 10 minutes; a reused retina slashes both bonds, and two missed scans forfeit half the bond and halt payouts 3 epochs. Bonds double per extra retina in one cluster, capped at 960 POA, so 100 fakes lock 92,130 POA against 3,000 POA for 100 honest users. Diseased eyes use a clinic-signed exemption and a doubled bond.
